name: Maggot baits
source:
Kantou, Pandemonium—

Once known as Kajou City, a central metropolis of the Kantou region. A few years ago, it was connected to the "Abyss," an alternate dimension where primal magic energy swirls, turning the place into a demonic city full of supernatural phenomena.

Upon the emergence of unidentifiable immortal "Witches," the government quarantined the metropolitan area and erased it from the national map, leaving it to ruin. 

After a while, the ghost town soon became a haven for criminals, illegal immigrants, and people with multiple debts who could not survive in the outside world. In addition, yakuza, black market merchants, and prostitutes also came to the city to take advantage of the situation.

The plot begins with a chance encounter between a man and a "Witch" in this free city of Pandemonium, whose unofficial population has grown to around 150,000.

In this wicked and lawless metropolis, the cruel fates of one man and the "Witches" begin to unfold.

[Based on[url=http://mangagamer.org/maggotbaits/] MangaGamer[/url] and [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/story.html] the official site[/url]]
translation:
关东，潘多莫尼亚——

这里曾名为嘉城，是关东地区的中心都市。数年前，它与名为“深渊”的异次元相连。原始魔力在深渊中翻涌，使这座城市变成充满超自然现象的恶魔都市。

无法辨认身份的不死“魔女”出现后，政府将都市圈隔离，并从全国地图上抹去它，任其走向毁灭。

不久，鬼城成为罪犯、非法移民以及无法在外界生存的多重负债者的避难所。黑帮、黑市商人与妓女也来到这里，想从混乱中获利。

故事始于一名男子与一位“魔女”的偶然相遇。这个自由都市潘多莫尼亚的非官方人口已经增长到约15万。

在这座邪恶而无法无天的大都市里，一个男人与“魔女”们的残酷命运开始展开。

[根据[url=http://mangagamer.org/maggotbaits/]MangaGamer[/url]及[url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/story.html]官方网站[/url]内容整理]
